push.title: L 0-2 vs Cuc United | You: 6.6 (4th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 6.6 against Cuc United is your 4th worst match performance of the season. The comeback starts tomorrow.

THE GOOD
+ 6 tackles attempted. You did the dirty work nobody claps for. Well, I'm clapping.
+ 2 key passes. You played the pass before the defense knew it was a possibility.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ Misplaced passes 6, from 10 in your previous match. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.

THE BAD
- Won 1 of 6 tackles (down from your usual 29%). Quick one: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away. You're closer than you think.
- Your 4th worst match performance of the season: 6.6. Fixable, every bit of it.
- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 1. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- That loss cost us one of our chances in Division 3. We win together and we wear this together.
- Dropped one to Cuc United, 0-2. Back to work.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 54% (7 of 13). I love you, but that wasn't football. That was a fire drill. Start here: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.

Try this in practice: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.

Between you and me, tuxedo_slide: Run like the ice cream truck just turned the corner.

Practice makes progress. - Coach Lasso

A 6.3 from you, BellyTb1. Bad day, good person, bright future.

THE GOOD
+ Pass accuracy 83%, up from your usual 68%. Bottle that and bring it next match.

- You and buddskees were in the same boat on defensive work rate. Row together: pass runners off and track them into the box.

Practice plan: Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.

BellyTb1, take this with you: Fall seven times, stand up eight, then ask for the ball.

On to the next one. - Coach Lasso
